lanes.summary: The diff precisely implements PMAT-3510. It adds the 4 requested Qwen 3.5 rungs with `required: true` and `backends: [cpu, cuda]` without the `hosts` key. It adds the `hosts:` mechanism to both the ladder runner and judge, enforcing ratcheting against origin/main to prevent dropping (rung, host) pairs. The runner explicitly bypasses RED-counting for non-listed hosts, and the 3 requested self-test cases are correctly implemented, two of which logically fail under the origin/main judge (missing skip and ratcheting logic).

lanes.summary: Diff satisfies PMAT-3510 completely: (1) adds the four required dense Qwen3.5 rungs (2B, 4B, 9B, 27B) with backends [cpu, cuda] and required: true without hosts: key; (2) implements optional per-rung hosts: support in contracts/model-capability-ladder-v1.yaml, scripts/check_model_ladder.sh (skip logic and anti-shrink ratchet), scripts/model_ladder.sh ([N/A] non-RED rows), and 3 discrimination self-test cases. Contains no forbidden kernel or forward code.

findings.claim: Adds four required rungs (qwen35-2b-q4km, qwen35-4b-q4km, qwen35-9b-q4km, qwen35-27b-q4km) with backends [cpu, cuda], required: true, and no hosts: key to contracts/model-capability-ladder-v1.yaml
Adds falsification tests FALSIFY-MCL-009 (per-rung host filtering / skip) and FALSIFY-MCL-010 (ratchet preventing dropped hosts vs origin/main)
Implements host floor anti-shrink ratchet in scripts/check_model_ladder.sh exiting 1 with 'hosts DROPPED on <rung> vs origin/main' when a rung's host set is narrowed
Judge skips rung on a host if the rung specifies hosts: and the host is not in that list
Runner model_ladder.sh emits hosts field and prints [N/A] row without incrementing RED when a host is not listed for a rung
Adds 3 self-test cases (green-rung-listed-one-host, red-dropped-host-on-rung, red-listed-host-absent) bringing the case suite to 18 cases, two of which fail under origin/main judge

3. Added falsification tests FALSIFY-MCL-009 and FALSIFY-MCL-010 along with 3 self-test fixture cases.
4. Diff contains no kernel or forward code.
